Phase 61 impl @ ca36dc7 (branch phase/framework-files-retire-what-nothing-reads). gate: see entry @ ca36dc7 — I did not run the full suite.

What changed
- tagteam/framework.py: _sources() -> docs/workflows.md only; new _retired_sources() (the 12 templates/checklists), Item.reconstructible (set in _classify's package-match and rendered-variant branches only), _plan_retired(), 'retire' action, _prune_retired_dirs() (rmdir, never recursive, only dirs this run emptied), projected_manifest() retired branch, report lines. SEED_DIRS loses templates + docs/checklists.
- tagteam/setup.py: needs_setup() keys on docs/workflows.md. tagteam/bench.py: package checklist fallback, project copy wins. tagteam/diagnostics.py: doctor lists a retired path only while a copy is on disk.
- Docs: tagteam/data/workflows.md, README.md (Safe migration + Retired files, --accept example), CLAUDE.md, docs/roadmap.md Getting Started (dead /handoff-* commands). Plan doc: your editorial note on the closing rationale applied.

Your two plan findings, as built
1. Historical manifest-only bytes go through recoverability(): test_historical_bytes_need_git_recovery (untracked -> kept, entry intact, second run identical; after commit -> retired, bytes still in git) and test_historical_bytes_untracked_go_with_accept_force.
2. test_failed_retire_keeps_provenance_and_the_retry_succeeds: os.unlink patched to PermissionError for one tracked historical path -> refused, exit 1, file + exact prior entry intact, other 11 retired; unpatched retry retires it and drops the entry.
Other criteria map to the 13 tests under the 'Phase 61' banner in tests/test_framework.py, tests/test_quickstart.py::TestNeedsSetup, tests/test_bench.py::test_prompt_checklist_falls_back_to_the_package, tests/test_diagnostics.py::test_retired_paths_show_only_while_a_copy_is_on_disk, and the wheel-installed run in tests/test_upgrade_smoke.py (old project now carries an untouched templates/cycle.md -> '- templates/cycle.md' in the diff).

Existing tests: ~30 in test_framework.py used templates/cycle.md as the generic managed-file subject; retargeted to docs/workflows.md (second subject: the vendored SKILL.md). Two were about shapes at templates/ being *refused*; that behaviour is deliberately gone, so they were replaced by test_odd_shapes_at_retired_paths_are_kept_not_refused rather than retargeted — please check that trade.

Item 8, this repo (tagteam setup --accept docs/workflows.md): 12x 'retired … matches the package', 'accepted docs/workflows.md (tracked and clean)', 'removed templates/ — empty'; second run: 'current 1 file(s)', manifest unchanged. docs/checklists/ was NOT pruned because it held a tracked .gitkeep — the never-recursive rule working as designed; I git rm'd that one file by hand. tagteam-manifest.json is now committed (it was untracked).

Verified by me: focused files only — test_framework (61), test_setup/quickstart/onboarding/worktree (101), test_diagnostics (54), test_upgrade_smoke (12), test_bench -k checklist (2); all passed. Environmental, not a defect: 2 upgrade_smoke tests failed on the unmodified tree too because .venv carried a stale tagteam-3.12.0 editable dist-info; I refreshed it (.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e . --no-deps), no repo file changed.

Not done / out of scope: the ~40-project upgrade sweep (release chore after merge); no version bump.

GATE: PASS | scope 32 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2044 passed, 5 skipped, 7m38s)
checked: HEAD ca36dc7

Approved implementation at ca36dc7. Reviewed the production diff, regression-test changes, docs, wheel-smoke coverage, and the reported repository retirement. Both plan-review findings are implemented: historical manifest-only bytes require recoverability (or explicit accepted force), and unsuccessful retirements preserve provenance for a later retry. Unsupported retired shapes are kept without writes; preimage checks remain on deletion; pruning is nonrecursive; bench preserves project checklist precedence with a package fallback. Retargeting managed-path tests to workflows/the vendored skill and replacing obsolete templates-directory refusal expectations is appropriate; docs-parent refusal coverage remains.

Verification: accepted GATE_PASS at HEAD ca36dc7 (2044 passed, 5 skipped). Reviewer focused run: tests/test_framework.py tests/test_bench.py -k 'retir or historical or checklist' -> 15 passed, 74 deselected. Full suite not rerun.

Nonblocking cleanup notes: _prune_retired_dirs silently skips OSError whereas the approved plan promised a directory-left-in-place note; consider reporting that outcome, especially permission failures. git diff --check reports trailing whitespace at README.md:54. Neither affects the retirement safety or blocks approval. The registered-project upgrade sweep and version bump remain outside this cycle.
